tips: B-cell activation readout. B_cells_CD86p: CD86+ (CD86 is up-regulated on antigen-engaged B cells as a T-cell co-stimulatory ligand). In-panel co-marker prior: HLA-DR (Comp-BV510-A) is constitutively high on B cells and is further up-regulated on activated B cells — complementary activation/APC-licensing readout.
